in_greek.name: Αθυστη
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word αθυσμα (athusma), meaning ‘no offering,’ or ‘no worship.’ The name is often used in the New Testament to refer to those who do not worship or serve God.

in_latin.name: Atyste
in_latin.long_meaning: Latinized form of the Greek name Αθυστη (Athyste)
